t: The LAP Sul outdoor LED solar wall light is a modern, wall-mounted exterior light designed to illuminate dark areas around domestic properties. This solar-powered fixture is ideal for lighting up front entrances, pathways and dark garden corners, providing extra security for homeowners. The durable black stainless steel body houses an integrated daylight LED bulb with a plastic diffuser, delivering 27 lumens of bright light. A built-in PIR sensor detects movement up to 8m away across a 120° angle, while the pre-set dusk-to-dawn sensor ensures efficient operation only when needed.
b: Supplied Fixings Ensure Quick & Easy Setup
